title: Flagged for review — irregularities this session could not settle, and what each one needs
rule: A flag is not a verdict. It records a conflict or a gap, with the files that show it. Nothing here blocks publication; every item is listed so the owner can decide after the site is live.

rows.issue: Three requirement registers answer the same 73 lines and disagree
rows.detail: The readiness register (14 implemented / 30 partial / 21 open), the round-2 review (19 met / 50 partial / 2 blocked / 1 open / 1 in progress) and the consolidated register (27 met / 38 partial) were all written from the same brief. 62 status disagreements are counted, 21 rows agree, 23 could not be matched on wording. No register is adopted here.
rows.needs: An owner decision on which rule governs 'met'. Suggested rule: the round-2 one, because it states a testable condition.

rows.issue: The settled-game count has four different values
rows.detail: nfl-core results_feed_2026.csv holds 272 rows, of which 137 are FINAL. nfl-markets holds 137 rows for 2026. nfl-marketboard's transcription holds 150. The brief says 136. The official standings read on 2026-11-19 implies at most 150 completed games (300 team-games / 2). No count is published as settled here. Separately, the only 136-row file in the repository is the originated-line file nfl-lines/data/derived/own_lines_week10.json (a forward schedule, 27 of its 136 fixtures carry any market number), so the brief's '136-game log' is most plausibly a count of fixtures with a fair line, not of settled games.

rows.issue: Every market price is blank, by policy, in the store that is called a price store
rows.detail: nfl-book's 39 open/close rows carry null market values. The nearest thing to a 'close' is a model run. nfl-markets' 12,573 rows come from a third-party archive. The brief's residual-against-the-market view therefore has no market side.
rows.needs: A licensed price series, or an explicit decision to publish model-only lines and stop calling the column 'market'.

rows.issue: A third-party correlation group is published beside the official one
rows.detail: nfl-markets/data/correlations.json mixes an official group with a flagged third-party group (covers, leg dependence). The brief requires correlations from officially sourced numbers only, with n on each value.
rows.needs: Page split and an n column on every published correlation.

rows.issue: The '6 of 254' game-designation claim cannot be reconciled to a stored copy
rows.detail: The brief says only 6 of 254 report rows carry a game designation. The copy it refers to is not in the repository. Measured from the stored, hash-verified 2026-11-18T23:49:17Z capture instead: 23 club tables, 242 player rows, 16 designated (9 Out, 7 Questionable), 226 blank — 6.6%. Same order of magnitude, different population. The stored capture also covers only 23 of the 32 clubs, so it is a partial week as well as a single snapshot.
rows.needs: The original 254-row copy, or acceptance of the dated recount in its place.

rows.issue: Houston's depth chart is an image and was not transcribed
rows.detail: 31 of 32 clubs were parsed from club depth pages. Houston publishes an image. It is left blank rather than transcribed by eye, so any 32-club depth feature is really a 31-club feature.
rows.needs: A structured Houston source (club or league) before coverage is called complete.

rows.issue: 27 of 32 club depth pages print no as-of date
rows.detail: A depth chart with no date cannot be versioned. The sweep stores the fetch date, which is a different fact from the club's own as-of date.
rows.needs: Either a club-published date or a capture cadence dense enough to bound staleness.

rows.issue: Only two availability captures exist, so no week can be replayed
rows.detail: A Week-10 rendered summary (2026-11-15T23:35Z) and a Week-11 raw HTML capture (2026-11-18T23:49:17Z). Neither is a Wednesday-to-kickoff series, and there is no inactive-list artifact at all.
rows.needs: The scheduled capture run on the cadence the brief specifies, kept indefinitely.

rows.issue: The repository holds 40 NFL namespaces with 40 flagged pages
rows.detail: Duplication counted across the NFL namespaces: 20 executive summaries, 35 suggestions pages, 44 flagged pages, 29 questions pages, 42 source pages. Only one namespace can be current; the rest are history or duplicates, and nothing says which. These counts are recomputed on every build and move whenever a peer session lands a workspace.
rows.needs: One live/history decision per namespace (suggestion S01).

rows.issue: 23 of 73 register rows could not be matched across registers
rows.detail: Ids differ (REQ-xx versus A01/B01/...) so rows were matched on exact normalised wording. 23 rows have no exact counterpart, which means their disagreement status is unknown, not settled.
rows.needs: A stable row id shared by all registers.

rows.issue: Two register rows cite a page that returned no body
rows.detail: REQ-57 and REQ-66 cite operations.nfl.com/the-rules. The read on 2026-11-19 returned no text, so those citations are unverified.
rows.needs: A successful read, or a different official citation for the rule text.

rows.issue: The root README still describes the NBA project
rows.detail: README.md at the repository root is the NBA line-origination project. The NFL work is in 40 sibling folders. The root dashboard now links here, but the README does not describe this work.
rows.needs: An owner decision on whether the repository is two projects or one.

rows.issue: No strategy is reward-eligible, and the required samples are large
rows.detail: All 15 rows of nfl-lines/data/derived/leaderboard.json are ineligible for reward (the nfl-arena copy repeats this with a Wilson interval). At the observed effect sizes, 80% power needs 1,148-1,290 bets per strategy; the largest current sample is 303 and the best gate score is 5 of 8. The leaderboard will stay empty for a long time.
rows.needs: Either a prospective sample accumulated over a season, or an explicit decision to change the reward definition.

rows.issue: No row-level publication policy is recorded
rows.detail: The site publishes derived tables, but raw captures also sit in the repository and are served by GitHub Pages. https://www.nfl.com/terms was not read line-by-line in this session, so no claim is made that the current split complies.
rows.needs: Read the terms against the published field list, then move raw captures to a private store if required.

rows.issue: Roof, surface and weather exist only in a third-party archive
rows.detail: nfl-markets/data/raw/games.csv carries roof, surface, temperature and wind from an unofficial source. The official game centre read on 2026-11-19 prints city and stadium but no roof or surface designation.
rows.needs: An official roof/surface designation per stadium, plus an NWS forecast capture.
